hero.description: The Icahn Medical Institute of the Mt. Sinai School of Medicine, located at 1425 Madison Avenue between East 98th and 99th Streets in the East Harlem neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, was built in 1997 and was designed by Davis Brody Bond. The building takes up the full block to Park Avenue, and is connected to the rest of the Mt. Sinai complex by a tunnel. (Source: AIA Guide to NYC (5th ed.))
